slices.focus: The full exhibition cycle completes without documentation scramble, validating the rebuilt system and Hannah's role
slices.summary: The large exhibition completes its full cycle (in and back out) without the old documentation scramble — object locations stayed correct, condition reports findable, crate records matching reality. Hannah presents a board-facing summary showing verified records near 98% and overdue catalog cleanup below the danger zone.
